Financials are also performing well, nearing their 52-week high and outperforming the SPY over the past 20 days. In contrast, the Tech sector is experiencing a decline, with a 20-day return of -5.9%. The Cloud sector is showing resilience, with a 20-day return of 5.0% and outperforming the SPY by 4.5 percentage points. These trends suggest a rotation towards sectors with more stable growth prospects.
markets_vol_view: The volatility regime is currently normal, with the VIX proxy at 17.04, indicating a moderate level of market uncertainty. The 20-day annualized volatility for various sectors shows a mixed picture, with Tech exhibiting high volatility at 33.7%, while Financials and Utilities display relatively lower volatility at 13.8% and 20.7% implied by their price-to-book ratios, respectively. The Energy and Healthcare sectors have volatilities of 19.8% and 22.2%, respectively, which are more in line with the broader market. This volatility landscape suggests that investors are differentiating between sectors, with some seeking safer havens and others embracing growth opportunities.
